title: M.Tech / PG Computer Science | KSDS KPGU
content: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, KSDS The Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) is dedicated for ensuring successful careers for its students. For us, this means creating deeper industry relations than ever before, forming a research culture from day one and ensuring seamless education using the best technology available anywhere. We strongly embolden innovation in research, teaching and service to the profession, the local community and industry.
